title.zh: 宣布Kuyamis节为东米萨米斯省官方节日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring the Kuyamis Festival as the Official Festival of the Province of Misamis Oriental
title.orig: An Act Declaring the Kuyamis Festival as the Official Festival of the Province of Misamis Oriental

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12275_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Kuyamis Festival is hereby declared the official festival of the Province of Misamis Oriental.
The second Friday of January of every year is hereby declared a special non-working holiday in the province in celebration of the Kuyamis Festival.

To carry out the purpose of this Act, there is hereby created a Special Festival Fund to be charged against any available fund of the province, including its share from the National Tax Allotment. The Province of Misamis Oriental is also authorized to receive donations and contributions from private individuals, corporations, and non-government organizations.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following the completion of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
